notes.title: Brotherhood joins the fight at Boomstock 2025! Demo available now!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44732631/c23a9f85e59d627d61fdb85d19f80129be9e6435.png[/img]  
Greetings, warriors!  
We’re excited to announce that [b]Brotherhood[/b] is part of [b]Boomstock 2025[/b] — The Boomer Shooter Celebration, the annual festival dedicated to classic FPS mayhem!  

From September 23 to 27, Steam transforms into a true celebration of old-school shooters, featuring leading studios such as Devolver Digital, New Blood Interactive, Apogee Entertainment, and many more.  

Here’s what you can look forward to:  
- New announcements and fresh trailers;  
- Huge discounts;  
- Plenty of demos, including [b]Brotherhood[/b];  
- In-game events, competitions, and giveaways.  

[h3]Brotherhood Demo[/h3]  
[b]Brotherhood[/b] is pure rage — a classic retro shooter inspired by Wolfenstein 3D, where there’s no room for mercy or hesitation. Just you, your shotgun, and endless hordes of enemies.  

And best of all — [b]the demo is available right now![/b] Jump in and experience Brotherhood firsthand.  

Share your impressions through the Steam Community or join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/89UKE37PuC]Discord[/url].  

[h3]Release Date[/h3]  
We’re planning to launch the game on PC and consoles this November. The exact date will be announced soon. Make sure to add it to your wishlist so you don’t miss the release!  

[previewyoutube=ZNXLSz6sqMY;full][/previewyoutube]  

[h2]Publisher’s Spotlight[/h2]  
Discover another project that’s also part of the old-school shooter festivities at [b]Boomstock 2025![/b]  

[b]HMUR[/b] is a wild ride of speed and chaos inspired by the cult shooters of the ’90s.  
The Playtest is already open, and you have the chance to be among the first on the battlefield. Participation even rewards you with an exclusive Golden Pistol skin.  

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3499560/HMUR/

notes.title: Brotherhood joins the Steam Debut Festival 2025!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44732631/a60a2e079b21c0de45ccb1468aa58bd1149cdf62.jpg[/img]
Greetings!  
[b]Brotherhood[/b] is part of the [b]Steam Debut Festival 2025[/b] — an event where debut games meet a wider audience for the very first time! This is my first major game, and I’m proud to share it with you — even if for now it’s only as a demo. But that’s just for now.

In the demo you can:
[list]
[*] Experience the old-school spirit — the true legacy of classic shooters inspired by Wolfenstein 3D.  
[*] Become a prisoner in an ancient fortress in the Swiss Alps, where many have succumbed to the power of a mutagen — but you are immune, making you a weapon of vengeance.  
[*] Explore intricate levels and wield weapons such as the shotgun, laser gun, rocket launcher, and more.  
[/list]
Thank you for supporting us — indie developers taking our very first steps.  
Try the demo, share your impressions, and join the discussion in the [url=https://discord.com/invite/89UKE37PuC]official Discord[/url] community!

[u][h2]Publisher’s Note[/h2][/u]  
Discover new genres, fresh ideas, and one-of-a-kind worlds crafted by passionate debut creators from around the globe — all as part of the Steam Debut Festival 2025.

These games are more than just first projects — they’re honest, heartfelt creations built with the pure love of making games.

notes.title: Brotherhood at Boomstock event and Presentation of the new trailer.
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44732631/dbc268b3591c83e7f27313ab4de9e33d6abb5bc8.png[/img]

[h3]Greetings, friends![/h3]
Development is in full swing. And I have some great news for you.

Brotherhood has become a participant of Boomstock Festival, organized by Fulqrum Publishing, dedicated to cool old-school action and retro games. I invite all of you to celebrate this event!
Buy great games at good discounts and play demo versions. Also during the festival you will see a lot of announcements from different development teams.

[h3]Brotherhood demo version is also available![/h3]

In honor of the festival I suggest you to watch a new gameplay trailer. The release is still planned for 2025, but there is no exact date yet.

[previewyoutube=ZNXLSz6sqMY;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Your requests and questions.[/h3]
If you enjoyed the demo and have any questions, feel free to join the [url=https://discord.gg/KnHFd4hS5w]Discord[/url] community and ask me directly.

Enjoy the game!
